## B. Bounded same-reviewer absence recovery — independent worktree
Files: selection.py, absence.py only a shared job-failure marker if needed, cli.py ensure-attempt marker if required, selection/attempt/CLI tests, recovery docs. Avoid A's test_attempts additions until integrate or use separate test module.
- Retry same reviewer first once after invalid/incomplete/empty/error absence, then continue normal chain; cap2 per reviewer and plan.max_attempts overall.
- No retry after quota/auth/timeout, job-level ensure-attempt error ('reviewer job did not finish'), disabled/ineligible/oversize/pool block. Keep job-level failure distinguishable without brittle raw model text matching (use shared marker/reason constant if compatible existing artifact schema).
- PASS/FAIL terminal; deterministic selection/replay same for live and replay. No cheaper reviewer escalation or same-head valid decision resampling.
Acceptance: eligible absent->same reviewer->verdict; two absences->pending; terminal->no retry; exclusions and max_attempts1; replay rejects third attempt or attempt after verdict; two-reviewer chain retries first before advancing. Existing workflow slots suffice, verified at CLI/workflow seam.
